title: Do yourself a favor - book this tour.
text: Amazing, personable and knowledgeable guide (Maria R). The places were great with delightful food and drinks. Not our first Devour food tour but one of the best.

title: Wonderful night of food and stories
text: Magical experience with Maria R. Great venues, wonderful stories, fabulous food, amazing drinks. We were royally entertained and have an insight into what it means to be from Seville. Highly recommended.
author: D4023EEwilliamm

title: Devour is 2 for 2 in excellent tours for me
text: Cate was a fabulous tour guide! Super friendly, knowledgeable, and accommodating. She brought the tour together super well and I had a blast
author: 580ashwinh

title: Wonderful experience
text: Cat is a great guild with a lot of knowledge. She showed us the most beautiful and most historic restaurants in Seville. Definitely a recommendation!
author: W7375WXrenees

title: Amazing experience having tapas
text: It was all fantastic, Catarina was amazing, we really enjoyed it.  This is my second Devour tour and it did not disappoint.
author: arneyw2026

title: Wonderful
text: Guillermo was a fantastic tour guide, knowledgeable of Sevilla's history and took us to all the great tapas spots. My husband and I appreciated that the tour did not feel overwhelming in any way, it was the perfect group size (there were 6 total), conversations flowed naturally and Guillermo did such a fantastic job at balancing between explaining the history or dishes while still giving each one of us the space and time to take it all in.  At no point did we feel rushed. We loved that we truly felt like we were hanging out with a local and not a tour guide – it made such a difference! I'll be
author: andreamE9915TY

title: Exceptional Evening of Food, Drink and Culture
text: We had a fantastic evening with Pilar as our guide. Our group size was perfect. We learned details about the city, history and culture, and got to experience exceptional local restaurants, food and drinks. A perfect evening of good company, learning, food and drink. Highly recommend this tour!
author: 425wendyj

title: Seville with Mario
text: Mario was wonderful! Full of information and tips. Good food and drinks at fun places. Even gave us tips for our next city which we used. Others on group were enthusiastic and friendly.
author: detcastle

title: Lovely food tour in Seville
text: Our guide, Pilar, was amazing!! We would definitely do it again just to have her guide us around telling us all about the history. All food and drinks were great and we had a lovely group to do it with as well.
author: D5718UUnicolew

title: Fun and informative
text: Pilar was phenomenal. She’s informative and personable, and provides wonderful insights into Seville’s food and wine culture.
